ascend.hardware_scope: Ascend 910C / A3; validation is specific to the selected runtime and workload

commands.list: capabilities without model or device execution
commands.accuracy: model and selected module outputs; no universal acceptance threshold
commands.performance: total model latency, throughput and allocator memory; independent TP communication sampling
commands.export: first fixed batch CPU native FX/ONNX graph; single-device preparation

preview.verified_meaning: complete execution, selected functions hit on every rank, finite checked output boundaries; not accuracy acceptance

limits: only listed model adapter is implemented
single-device FlagCX comparison is not applicable
eager execution may not call the Triton compiler
FlagCX lifecycle is scoped to one-shot workers
2/4/8 TP parameter support does not imply hardware qualification at every scale
graph export does not verify ONNX Runtime or vendor engine numerics
call-level routing is not hardware kernel fallback coverage
